long: Manhunt is a stealth-based survival horror game in which death-row inmate James Earl Cash is forced to commit brutal executions for a sadistic director filming snuff videos. Players lurk in shadows, distract enemies and time silent kills of varying violence to progress through a decaying urban hell. It is known for its grim tone and tense hide-and-stalk gameplay.
